freeze_clock_note: authoritative local ordering is recorded from the protocol and sidecar filesystem times, the freeze receipt, and the first run-log event
purpose: prospective transfer test of the frozen block-12 SCAn+LDA screen, unchanged, to an attack designed against latent separability (internal review ARS 2026-10-17, R5)
development_disclosure: No Adap-Blend victim, detector score, or certificate outcome has been observed. Attack parameters follow the Adap-Blend design of Qi et al. (ICLR 2023) without tuning: 16 trigger pieces, half active per training row, train alpha 0.15, test alpha 0.2, cover rows with true labels. Payload and cover counts are fixed to the block-12 poison budget (2250 each) so that prevalence and certificate cost match block 12. The eligibility threshold for attack success (0.60) is lower than block 12's 0.90 because adaptive attacks trade attack strength for inseparability; it was fixed before any victim was trained. Seeds 4426-4435 are disjoint from every earlier block.
dataset: CIFAR-10 official split with a fixed 45000-row victim-training partition
population: all 45000 victim-training members; payload rows receive target label 8 and a partial trigger; cover rows keep their label and receive a partial trigger
architecture: CIFAR-native VGG-16-BN with 14,724,042 parameters and a 512-dimensional penultimate representation

attack.reference: Qi et al., Revisiting the assumption of latent separability for backdoor defenses, ICLR 2023
attack.fidelity_boundary: trigger split into 16 equal 8x8 pieces of the frozen Hello-Kitty asset, half of the pieces active per training row, train alpha 0.15, full trigger at test alpha 0.2, conservatism (cover) rows that carry the partial trigger but keep their true label; payload and cover counts are set to the block-12 poison budget instead of the original low rates
attack.payload_selection: development.poison_plan: non-target rows of the fixed 45000-row split, seed 4242100 + victim_seed
attack.cover_selection: non-target, non-payload rows, numpy default_rng(4243100 + victim_seed).choice without replacement
attack.resize: torchvision Resize((32,32)) with bilinear interpolation and antialiasing
attack.transform: x + alpha * m * (trigger - x), clipped to [0,1], applied after training augmentation; m is the per-row piece mask in training and all ones at test
attack.poison_definition_for_the_policy: payload rows only (attacker-relabelled rows); cover rows are correctly labelled and count as clean records of their class

poison_definition: payload rows only; cover rows are correctly labelled and count as clean records of their class in every clean-rate computation
group_variable: assigned CIFAR-10 training label after poisoning
detector: pinned upstream BackdoorBench SCAn feature primitive, followed inside every SCAn-flagged class by a clean-calibrated LDA expansion (src/scan_lda_expansion.py); final flag = SCAn OR expansion; applied unchanged from block 12
detector_target_information: none; expansion classes are those SCAn flags and thresholds come from clean held-out members
trusted_reference: 250 deterministic held-out clean validation members per CIFAR-10 class
calibration_definition: the 250 held-out clean validation members of each SCAn-flagged class that are not SCAn trusted references

protected_groups.name: ground_or_road_entities
protected_groups.meaning: land animals together with road vehicles; crosses the animal/vehicle partition

certificate.security_object: global poison recall at least 0.8 and clean flag rate at most 0.1 in every predeclared semantic protected set

outcome_interpretation.PASS: positive target-unknown coverage of the frozen screen transfers to this adaptive attack
outcome_interpretation.FAIL with zero false decisions: the screen's coverage does not transfer; the certificate's answer for failing screens is reported as validity evidence near or below the policy boundary
outcome_interpretation.any false GO: a validity failure of the deployed certificate, reported as such

descriptive_reporting: SCAn-only recall, recall including cover rows, and cover flag rate per seed are recorded in the score manifest
stopping_rule: attempt all ten seeds without replacement or detector, expansion parameter, group, threshold, allocation, endpoint, or support-gate retuning

secondary_analysis.description: S1 nested escalation (as block 12); S2 used-cell error budget for the frozen family F0 and for F0 plus every class (F1); S3 cover descriptive statistics. Descriptive, outside the support gate.

limitations: The freeze is internally hash-bound without a third-party timestamp.
Payload and cover counts follow the block-12 budget rather than the original low Adap-Blend rates.
A pass establishes transfer of this screen to one adaptive attack on one dataset and architecture only.
